theme: An open Saturday before the week turns over.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan — nothing on the calendar at all. It's the rare clear day to close out the board's oldest bookings before the girls are back tomorrow evening.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Top-priority item on the Mike + Dan board, open since Sept 14. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — a held booking costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive-down window ends tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 Portland to St Pete gap closes Sunday. Driving the Pathfinder south now is what kills the monthly Florida rental cost, so the window matters more than the miles.

needsAttention.title: December break not yet decided
needsAttention.detail: Board item flagged to decide by Sept 30 and book by Oct 15 — both dates have now passed. Holiday inventory for six over a three-week window is the thinnest of the year.

needsAttention.title: Review ICGN plenary 7 outlines
needsAttention.detail: Claudia Rossetti sent the session outlines to read before the planning call, now set for Friday Oct 23 at 7:30 ET. An open day is the time to go through them.
